cross_version_policy.future_use: GKG 2.1 may be evaluated later as a source-only robustness bridge under a separately frozen calibration protocol.
cross_version_policy.reason: GKG 2.x is structurally document-level and retains V1ORGANIZATIONS, but its monitored document population includes GDELT 2.x source/translation features. Mixing only gap dates into the primary series would create a localized source-generation regime change.

next_if_pass: Close primary GKG 1.0 attention acquisition with fail-closed month eligibility, then freeze the H3 statistical specification before any outcome join.

primary_month_rule.security_month_eligible: global calendar month is eligible AND security-month PIT-active source coverage >= 0.90
primary_month_rule.undercovered_month_treatment: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_PRIMARY_H3; never zero-filled and never partially retained cross-sectionally

purpose: Preserve the previously frozen 90% source-coverage threshold without imputing, relaxing thresholds, or mixing GDELT product generations in the primary H3 attention series.
timing_consequence: When attention at month t is unavailable, every H3 specification using attention_t to predict an outcome at t+1 must exclude that t->t+1 observation before outcomes are read.
